input.captured_output:
$ dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version}\n' ca-certificates
ca-certificates 20260816ubuntu0.24.04.1
$ dpkg --compare-versions "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' ca-certificates)" ge 20260816ubuntu0.24.04.1 && echo at-or-above || echo below
at-or-above
$ BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
parsed 121 certificates, 0 matched
$ grep -c 'BEGIN CERTIFICATE' /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
121

note: Ubuntu's package version carries the fix under its own numbering. The version floor and the store read agree, which is the strongest negative a system bundle gives; the version alone would only say at-or-above.
